title: Worth to try premium
body:
I am so grateful to have received the scholarship for the premium account of this habit tracker app. I have been using the free version for a while, but I quickly realized that I needed more features to help me stay motivated and achieve my goals. The premium account has been a lifesaver! I am now able to track all of my habits, set reminders, and see reports on my progress. This has helped me to stay on track and make more progress than ever before.

    I am also impressed with the customer support of this app. I had a few questions when I first started using it, and the customer support team was always quick to respond and helpful. They really went above and beyond to help me get started.

    I highly recommend this habit tracker app to anyone who is looking to improve their habits and achieve their goals. The premium account is definitely worth the investment!

title: 100000% Recommended! Brilliantly done.
body: I was spending days trying to find a perfect and affordable app for habit tracking. Well, other popular apps are somewhat overestimated, plus overpriced. After searching for like 20 or more articles introducing habit tracking tools, I had tried all of them but definitely fell in love at first sight with this one. It is well designed, easy to use, elegant and stunning to look at, and comfortable enough for users’ customization. It also has some interesting functions like joining with friends or habit recommendations. And, woala, the price is only around 110,000 VND (~5 USD) for one-time payment, which is kinda 1/6 cheaper compared to other well-known same-function apps, and that is just their annually billed price. Overall, I am such into this Habit tracker and really recommend it to everyone finding a magnificent habit tracking tool.
